sloka: ततः प्रभाते जनकः कृत कर्मा महर्षिभिः ।उवाच वाक्यम् वाक्यज्ञः शतानंदम् पुरोहितम् ॥१-७०-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte janakaḥ kṛta karmā maharṣibhiḥ ।uvāca vākyam vākyajñaḥ śatānaṁdam purohitam ॥1-70-1॥

translations.english: Thereafter at dawn after the maharshis had performed their daily (sacrificial) rites the eloquent Janaka said to the chief priest Satananda:
